acceptance: The owner approves this offer in context (date, approver) before anything is posted upstream.

An upstream pull request for the reduced duckdb-order-by-all-keyword change is opened and linked; patches.json moves duckdb-order-by-all-keyword to upstream_state offered with that tobymao/sqlglot URL and a reason saying where it stands.
The upstream PR's tests pass on the real engine locally or in upstream CI, with the evidence recorded in context.
closing_note: Offer complete. tobymao/sqlglot#9310 (PostgreSQL case) was closed as not planned; the narrowed tobymao/sqlglot#9331 was fixed upstream by #9332 (v30.34.0): ClickHouse and Snowflake parse ORDER BY ALL as the keyword. duckdb-order-by-all-keyword stays carried for sources that parse ALL as a column, such as PostgreSQL; its test was renamed in #148 so upstream's new test_order_by_all is not shadowed. Manifest record (declined, links #9310/#9331/#9332) is in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot#154, which replaces the closed draft #136.
context:
Decision gate (owner): approve this offer before any upstream contact.

Verification rubric: (1) the reduced change applies to current upstream main; (2) its dialect tests pass on the real engine; (3) the fork's downstream contract tests pass after the patches.json edit.

Guardrails: no pull request, issue or comment on tobymao/sqlglot until the owner approves this specific offer in this item's context; the offered change must be the fork patch reduced to upstream-only behaviour; the patch stays carried in patches.json until upstream merges and a refresh retires it with equivalence evidence.

Upstream rules (tobymao/sqlglot AGENTS.md): Conventional Commits title ending with the agent model ([CLAUDE], [CODEX]); minimal scope; tests in tests/dialects that run on the real engine; no fork-only behaviour or benchbox package references.

Owner approval 2026-11-21 (Joe Harris, choice dialog): approved for upstream offer to tobymao/sqlglot.

2026-11-21: offered as https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/9310 with fork commit eb0c3f0a (branch upstream/duckdb-order-by-all-keyword, built on upstream main 089891f2). Reduced change = fork patch unchanged; applies cleanly to upstream main. Verified on DuckDB 2.0.1: upstream main's ORDER BY "ALL" fails with 'Binder Error: Referenced column "ALL" not found in FROM clause!'; all 8 patched outputs (GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL, ORDER BY ALL DESC, a UNION ALL, a subquery, each with and without identify) run. tests.dialects.test_duckdb passes (78 tests); the full upstream suite (1770 tests) has only the two environment errors base also has; no new ruff findings. Filed as an issue because upstream accepts pull requests only from collaborators. Fork patches.json moves the entry to offered in branch chore/record-bigquery-duckdb-offers. Next: when upstream fixes the issue, a refresh retires the patch with equivalence evidence; until then it stays carried.

2026-11-23: upstream (georgesittas) closed tobymao/sqlglot#9310 as not planned: the PostgreSQL example made the motivation unclear, since PostgreSQL has no ORDER BY ALL. With owner approval (2026-11-23, chat) I replied at https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/9310#issuecomment-7102909949 with the real case and asked for a reopen: ClickHouse and Snowflake support ORDER BY ALL, but sqlglot sets SUPPORTS_ORDER_BY_ALL only for DuckDB, Spark/Databricks and SingleStore, so read=clickhouse/snowflake, write=duckdb gives ORDER BY "ALL", which DuckDB rejects with a binder error. The narrowed offer is fork commit 11305387 (branch upstream/order-by-all-snowflake-clickhouse, on upstream main ae01f91c): set the flag for both dialects, with tests in test_dialect.py::test_order_by. Verified: the source query runs on ClickHouse via chDB 26.11; upstream main output fails on DuckDB 2.0.1; patched output returns the same rows as ClickHouse; full suite 1777 tests with only the two environment errors base also has; ruff format clean. The narrowed fix does not cover PostgreSQL input, so duckdb-order-by-all-keyword stays carried for that case even if upstream merges it. patches.json reason updated in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot#136. Next: wait for the maintainer; if it stays closed, record the patch as declined.

2026-11-23: upstream (georgesittas) asked for a new issue rather than reopening #9310. Filed https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/9331 with the narrowed fix (fork commit 11305387, branch upstream/order-by-all-snowflake-clickhouse; merges cleanly onto upstream main d3a2eafd, with no upstream changes to the touched files since it was built). Evidence as recorded above; Snowflake relies on its documentation because the account is suspended. patches.json now lists #9310 and #9331 in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot#136. Next: wait for upstream on #9331; the fork patch stays carried for PostgreSQL input either way.
